root_cause.text: The `bpf_xdp_store_bytes` helper prototype incorrectly defined the source pointer argument as requiring write access (`ARG_PTR_TO_UNINIT_MEM`), causing the verifier to reject valid memory reads from read-only BPF maps.
root_cause.evidence: The patch modifies `net/core/filter.c` to change `.arg3_type` from `ARG_PTR_TO_UNINIT_MEM` to `ARG_PTR_TO_MEM | MEM_RDONLY`, and the CVE description confirms the original type included the `MEM_WRITE` flag which triggered the "write into map forbidden" error when accessing `BPF_F_RDONLY_PROG` maps.
